{"markdown":"# Issues Memo — Licence Agreement (Customer Side)

**To:** Deal team  
**From:** In-house counsel  
**Re:** Playbook review — hosted FX trading platform licence  
**Status:** 19 findings reviewed — 12 deviations/gaps, 5 compliant

---

## 1. Executive summary

The draft is materially one-sided and, as written, breaches our playbook at several walk-away points. The three critical issues are risk allocation: Article XII imposes a broad one-way indemnity on us with no Licensor indemnity at all and Article XIII excludes Licensor from liability for third-party IP infringement claims arising from the Platform; the liability cap and consequential-damages exclusion protect Licensor only, are set at one half of amounts actually paid, and carry no carve-outs for confidentiality, data/security, indemnities, fraud or IP; and the Agreement is silent on ownership of our trading, client and configuration data, defining "Intellectual Property Rights" solely by reference to Licensor's rights.

Commercial flexibility is equally constrained: we have no termination-for-convenience right in a 36-month committed term while Licensor may terminate immediately on any breach of any covenant; renewal is a seven-year extension exercisable unilaterally by Licensor; assignment is barred outright with automatic termination on our change of control and a right of first refusal over a sale of our business; and the licence runs to Licensee employees only, excluding our Affiliates and the contractors who operate our desk. On exit, Article XXI requires us to return everything within five days with no transition assistance, no data export and no deletion certification. There is no performance warranty (pure "AS IS") and no insurance covenant despite Licensor hosting the Platform, the Hardware and our data.

Five areas are compliant and require no redline: exclusivity, liquidated damages/penalties, governing law and venue (New York, exclusive jurisdiction, no arbitration), MFN, and minimum purchase commitments.

---

## 2. Findings

| # | Severity | Rule | Status | Section | Our position |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Critical | INDEMN — Indemnification by Vendor | Deviation | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | Add a Licensor indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data incidents and wilful misconduct. |
| 2 | Critical | IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data | Deviation | § II Licence Grant and Restrictions I. | Add a Licensee ownership sentence for our data and any customer-funded customisations. |
| 3 | Critical | LOL-CAP — Limitation of liability | Deviation | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | Make the cap mutual, reset to the greater of 12 months' fees / USD 1M, and carve out indemnities, confidentiality, IP and wilful misconduct. |
| 4 | High | ASSIGN — Assignment and change of control | Deviation | GENERAL PROVISIONS | Permit assignment to Affiliates/successors and delete automatic termination on our change of control; delete the Article XXII right of first refusal. |
| 5 | High | LICENSE — Licence grant scope | Deviation | § II Licence Grant and Restrictions I. | Extend the licence to Affiliates and contractors and make it irrevocable during the term absent uncured material breach. |
| 6 | High | T4C — Termination for convenience | Deviation | § II Licence Grant and Restrictions I. | Add a Licensee right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund; limit Licensor's right to uncured material breach. |
| 7 | High | NONCOMPETE — Non-compete restrictions on Customer | Deviation | § I Certain Definitions | Confirm the Field of Use restriction limits only use of the Licensed Technology and does not restrain our business. |
| 8 | High | EXCLUSIVITY — Exclusivity obligations | Compliant | § II Licence Grant and Restrictions I. | Non-exclusive both ways; no redline required. |
| 9 | High | LD — Liquidated damages and penalties | Compliant | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | No LDs, penalties or termination payment; audit cost-shift at >5% is within our position. No redline. |
| 10 | Medium | RENEWAL — Auto-renewal and notice window | Deviation | § II Licence Grant and Restrictions I. | Replace Licensor's unilateral 7-year renewal option with mutual 12-month renewals and uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%. |
| 11 | Medium | TRANSITION — Transition assistance and data return | Missing | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | Add up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in machine-readable form, certified deletion and a regulatory retention carve-out. |
| 12 | Medium | WARRANTY — Performance warranty and duration | Deviation | WARRANTY DISCLAIMER | Add a workmanlike-services warranty, conformance to Documentation, no-malicious-code, and a re-perform/repair/refund remedy carved out of the AS-IS disclaimer. |
| 13 | Medium | NOSOLICIT — Non-solicitation of employees | Deviation | CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION/NON SOLICITATION | Make the non-solicit mutual, cut it to 12 months post-term and limit it to personnel directly involved in the Agreement. |
| 14 | Medium | AUDIT — Audit rights against Customer | Deviation | 50+ US$5.00 | Limit audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' notice, during business hours, confidentiality-bound auditor, no access to our systems. |
| 15 | Medium | GOVLAW — Governing law and venue | Compliant | GENERAL PROVISIONS | New York law and exclusive NYC jurisdiction match our position; prevailing-party fee shifting is acceptable but we may propose deletion. |
| 16 | Medium | MFN — Most-favoured-nation obligations | Compliant | § II Licence Grant and Restrictions I. | No MFN or matching obligation on us; nothing to redline. |
| 17 | Medium | MINCOMMIT — Minimum purchase commitments | Compliant | 50+ US$5.00 | Usage-based pricing with no minimum, take-or-pay or shortfall; no redline required. |
| 18 | Low | INSURANCE — Vendor insurance | Missing | GENERAL PROVISIONS | Insert a short insurance covenant (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, certificates on request). |

---

## 3. Walk-away items

These sit at or beyond our playbook walk-away line and must be resolved before signature:

1. **No Licensor indemnity, plus an express exclusion of IP-infringement liability** (Article XII / Article XIII) — we cannot accept a one-way indemnity that covers the mere exercise of our licence rights and the conduct of our business.
2. **One-way liability cap at half of amounts paid, with no Excluded Claims**, compounded by our assumption in Article II of "all liabilities and risks associated with the use of the system".
3. **Silence on ownership of our data**, combined with Article XXI, which leaves our trading, client and configuration data with Licensor.
4. **Assignment and change of control** — blanket bar on our assignment with no affiliate/M&A carve-out or reasonableness standard (Article XXIV(c)), automatic termination on our change of control, and a competitor-acquirer consent veto.
5. **No termination for convenience** across a 36-month committed term, against Licensor's right to terminate immediately on any breach of any covenant.
6. **Licensor's unilateral seven-year renewal option** with no cap on renewal pricing.
7. **No transition assistance or data return** — five-day return of everything, no export, no deletion certification, on a hosted platform.
8. **Pure "AS IS" disclaimer** that even disclaims that errors or non-conformity to Documentation can or will be corrected, with no performance warranty anywhere.
9. **No insurance covenant** where Licensor hosts the Platform and Hardware and handles our trading and client data (absence of E&O and cyber cover).
10. **Three-year one-way non-solicit** covering all Licensor and Affiliate employees — beyond our 24-month limit.

---

## 4. Next steps

1. Issue the redline implementing the proposals in the table, leading with the three critical items (INDEMN, LOL-CAP, IP) and the assignment/change-of-control package.
2. Flag the ten walk-away items to the business as gating; confirm we have authority to hold on each before the first negotiation call.
3. Raise as commercial (non-legal) asks: service credits, which are absent alongside the missing warranty; an MFN in our favour; and deletion of the Article XXIV(d) prevailing-party fee shift.
4. Confirm with the desk which Affiliates and contractors require Platform access so the licence-scope redline is accurate.
5. Confirm our regulatory record-retention requirements to size the carve-out in the transition/data-deletion language.
6. No action required on exclusivity, liquidated damages, governing law, MFN or minimum commitments."}
